theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂
  case refl.refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case refl.red_I => exact ⟨_, .red_I _, .refl _⟩
  case refl.red_K => exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, .refl _⟩
  case refl.red_S => exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .refl _⟩
  case refl.par ha hb => exact ⟨_, .par ha hb, .refl _⟩
  case red_I.refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
  case red_I.red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha => cases hc; exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_K.red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K.par hk hb =>
    cases hk
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    · next hx hy => cases hx; exact ⟨_, hy, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_S.refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
  case red_S.red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S.par hs hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hs
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩
  case par.refl ha hb => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
  case par.red_I hc ha => cases hc; exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ha⟩
  case par.red_K hb hk =>
    cases hk
    · exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, .refl _⟩
    · next hx hy => cases hx; exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, hy⟩
  case par.red_S hb _ _ hs =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hs
    exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  case par.par ha hb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
